title: Gate-6B Mode-I Adaptive-Localization Stage 7: Layered Companion-Element / All_elem Reference-Fidelity Test
executive_summary: In authoritative f42_mixed_uel.for, companion UMAT sets STRESS = 0.D0 and DDSDDE = 1.D-11 to prevent structural stiffness double-counting with UEL Layer 2. Consequently, Cauchy stress on All_elem is identically zero and Abaqus evaluates MISESERI = 0.0 everywhere. This proves that Layer 3 is exclusively an SDV visualizer and cannot generate pre-analysis error indicators.

subroutine_audit.layer1_phase_uel: Solves phase-field Helmholtz equation, writes trial d to /CB_STATE_TRANS/
subroutine_audit.layer2_mech_uel: Solves degraded elasticity, supplies true AMATRX stiffness and RHS force, updates H
subroutine_audit.layer3_companion_umat: Sets STRESS = 0.D0 and DDSDDE = 1.D-11, reads /CB_STATE_TRANS/, writes SDV1..SDV20
